CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.
   D. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Responsibility over Plants.
   B. Say Responsibility over Plants has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Responsibility over Plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)
   A. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.
   C. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Prophecies about the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophecies about the Messiah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Prophecies about the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Prophecies about the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Functions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Functions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Functions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Functions of the Bible.
   D. Apply the teaching of Functions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of John the Baptist to the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Use John the Baptist to the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say John the Baptist to the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing John the Baptist to the Messiah.
   D. Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.
   C. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.
   D. Use The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Accounts of Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Accounts of Creation.
   C. Use Accounts of Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Forms of Worship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Role of the Church in Education and Health 5 6.0 Christian Living Today 6.1 Huma and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Role of the Church in Education and Health and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality 7 6.2 Christian Marriage and Family 7 6.3 Alcohol, drugs and sub and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
